product.title: Carmel Small Group Walking Food and Cultural Tour

description.text: Explore Carmel-by-the-Sea on a small-group walking food and cultural tour with tastings at local restaurants and specialty shops. A guide shares village history while the route covers hidden courtyards, galleries, and signature Carmel flavors.

highlights: Small-group Carmel food and wine walking tour
Multiple tastings at local restaurants and shops
Explore hidden courtyards and village lanes
Guide shares Carmel history and architecture
Maximum group size keeps the route intimate

start.description: Meet at the confirmed Carmel-by-the-Sea meeting point listed in your booking confirmation.
